$comment: schema_version 1.0.0; validates records in lineage.jsonl.  STATUS: OAS v1.0 TARGET schema, NOT yet in force. ADR-0034 §1 freezes a spec only when all four conditions hold; conditions 2 (spec doc 'Adopted') and 3 (>=3 design-partner sign-offs) are open as of 2026-08-02, so the spec is in pre-freeze draft status. The in-force schema an installed CLI validates against is the packaged copy under src/novafabric/schemas/, which keeps the original $id. See ADR-0223.
title: LineageEdge
description: One directed edge in the NovaFabric lineage graph, stored as a JSONL record.

schema_version.description: OAS v1.0 schema version. Must be 1.x.x (ADR-0034 §1).

edge_type.description: Phase 3 four-type causal/compositional vocabulary (ADR-0044), the grouping edge member_of_session (ADR-0122 D3), and the memory-provenance pair wrote_memory/read_memory (ADR-0143 P1). The memory pair is split by direction on purpose: a poisoned-read back-trace must distinguish who WROTE a bad item from who READ it. member_of_session is deliberately NOT part of the parent/child schema: a session groups N independent runs, which is orthogonal to one execution's internal structure. Legacy strings (consumed, produced_by, derived_from, evaluated_by, attested_by, depends_on) are coerced by coerce_legacy_edge_type() and must not appear in new records.
